comparison_scalar_carrier.source: Installed official PyTorch wheel headers, no PyTorch runtime dependency on GPU hosts

rewrites.change: Specialize scalar_t to FP16, act_first=true, use_vec=false, HAS_CLAMP=false, alpha=1, beta=0, and d to each declared hidden width
rewrites.status: The public host selects scalar fallback for these widths and launches grid=tokens/block=min(hidden,1024)

rewrites.change: Inline compute and SiLU helpers, retaining activation half rounding before the gate multiply; spell casts as explicit half conversion intrinsics
rewrites.status: Adapted source is proved; the source rewrite itself has no equivalence theorem

rewrites.change: Flatten local pointer aliases into row-major offsets, replace VLLM_LDG with ordinary scalar loads, and spell for as while in one extern C kernel
Use int32 token and loop indices instead of upstream int64
rewrites.status: Semantic departure, bounded by the proved input span <2^31 and positive native launch geometry

scope: Independent scalable scalar SiLU-and-mul adaptation from a public November 10 revision, not the authors' missing registry source or production pass rates. Retains the native multiwave launch and strided loop. Packed vector branches, general upstream/source-rewrite equivalence, IEEE guarantees and NVIDIA execution are not claimed.
